fact: The 2026 budget volume lists GH¢30,000,000 for rural telephony, GH¢70,000,000 for the Digital Youth Village, GH¢100,000,000 for One Million Coders and GH¢138,000,000 for the World Bank-funded e-Ghana project.
title: 2026 Budget Volume: Ministry 026 Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
